Beth —

Quick turnaround on the canary snapshot we ran Wed evening. TL;DR: the run used the ACME conversational profile (same sequence lengths + bot/user ratios). Summary:

- p50 latency: 85ms (single-token generation baseline)
- p95 latency: 310ms (spiky tail; correlated with long context requests)
- p99 latency: 790ms (very rare long-context cases)
- sustained throughput: 36 qps with 8 concurrent workers on the dedicated pool

Notes: the p95 exceeds your 220ms goal in the current config. Root causes flagged: small prefix caching hit-rate (~20%), and suboptimal batching for mixed sequence lengths.

I've uploaded the raw runs: latency_results_q2.csv and canary-logs.zip to the shared drive (link in the MAP doc). Immediate next steps I recommend:

1) Short-term (this week): enable prefix/KV prefetching + increase batch max for homogeneous short sessions (owner: Rishi)
2) Mid-term (1–2 weeks): test 4-bit quantized variant for the encoder layers (owner: Marcus)
3) Operational: add a golden prompt set to the MAP for regression gating (owner: Monica)

I'll bring a short slide with the request profile and tail analysis to the sync.

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra

Date: 2028-04-09T15:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan — performance checkpoint & close timeline

Adding a bit more color on the tuning path and owners —

Action items (proposed)
- A1: Enable prefix/KV prefetch & raise batching cap for short-session traffic — Owner: Rishi; ETA: 2028-04-11 end of day
- A2: Evaluate 4-bit quantization on canary worker (encoder-only first) — Owner: Marcus; ETA: 2028-04-18 for bench results
- A3: Golden prompt set + automated regression check in the MAP — Owner: Monica; ETA: 2028-04-12
- A4: Operational runbook for fallback (model variant + regional reroute) — Owner: Stephanie & ACME SRE; ETA: 2028-04-15

Performance trade-offs to flag:
- 4-bit quant reduces memory & can increase throughput by ~15–35% but may add a small p95 latency jitter until kernels are tuned. We'll gate by the gated evals in the MAP.
- Increasing batching helps throughput but raises median latency slightly for single-token interactive scenarios; we'll use dynamic batch caps tied to latency SLOs.

Attachments: perf-notes.pdf (detailed tuning plan)

I'll be available at the Thu 14:00 PT slot for the demo and can bring a quick canary comparison dashboard.

-marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Performance Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: 2028-04-11T16:45:00Z
Subject: Weekly checkpoint notes + confirmed next steps (MAP update)

Team — thanks for the quick responses and for confirming Thu 2028-04-10 14:00 PT for the checkpoint. Meeting notes & agreed actions below (captured in MAP_v1.xlsx).

Summary of the checkpoint:
- Canary snapshot reviewed: baseline throughput 36 qps; p95 tail at 310ms. Not meeting ACME's p95 <= 220ms target under current config.
- Agreed immediate mitigations: A1 (Rishi) to enable prefix prefetch and increase batch cap for short sessions; A3 (Monica) to produce golden prompt set for regression gating; ACME SRE to validate fallback routing in test cluster.
- Mid-term: Marcus to run quantized encoder experiments (A2) and report bench delta next week.
- Procurement: ACME to circulate PO template by 2028-04-14; target RMS close window: 2028-04-21 assuming perf gate clears.

Action owners & deadlines (copied from MAP):
- Rishi Malhotra — A1: platform config change + 24-hour canary (ETA 2028-04-11 EOD) — deliverables: updated canary logs + latency_results_q2.csv
- Monica Patel — A3: golden prompt set + gating automation (ETA 2028-04-12) — deliverable: gating checklist in MAP_v1.xlsx
- Marcus Lin — A2: quant bench (ETA 2028-04-18) — deliverable: bench summary + perf-notes.pdf
- Stephanie Nguyen & ACME SRE — A4: fallback runbook draft (ETA 2028-04-15)
- ACME Procurement — PO template circulation (ETA 2028-04-14)

Risks & contingencies:
- If p95 remains >220ms after short-term mitigations, plan B is to enable regional reroute to a lower-latency cluster while we finish quant tuning. That will impact cost; we'll surface estimate in the next update.

Next checkpoint: weekly cadence; next sync Thu 2028-04-17 14:00 PT to review A1 results & decide on quant rollout.

Related links: MAP_v1.xlsx in the shared drive, benchmark artifacts at the Drive link, and HubSpot deal page (link above).

Thanks —
